theSettingsSectionISRendered_measured: The captured settings pane shows the section and its declaration: header `╭─ MPD 插件包 (mpd) ─… [重启生效] ╮`, page indicator `1/42`, the 22 mpd fields, and — as the last nine rows — the NINE team-model slot rows WITH their values: `槽位 1 提供商 ‹ DeepSeek ›`, `槽位 1 模型 ‹ DeepSeek-V4-Flash ›`, `槽位 1 推理强度 ‹ Max ›`, then the same three for 槽位 2 (High) and 槽位 3 (High). Raw text: pane-extract.txt + case-run/settings.pane.txt.

whyNeverLostCannotBeVisible.explanation: Every mpd knob hint is `mpd.jsonc <key> — <BRIDGE_DISCLOSURE> <BRIDGE_NOT_LOST>[ <semantics>]` (knobHint in packages/mpd-config-plugin/src/settings-schema.ts). BRIDGE_DISCLOSURE is 272 chars, so 'never lost' (inside BRIDGE_NOT_LOST, 187 chars) starts at offset 320 — beyond the 220-char pane line, and the TUI truncates the hint at ~char 170 to leave room for the key footer. The clause IS composed into the hint (proven in bytes: BRIDGE_NOT_LOST present in the TUI dist and the shared schema; 1 hit) but is not VISIBLE at this case's geometry, for ANY row (all share that prefix).

caseStrengtheningHistory.evidence: Across all 47 recorded evidence/tui/lanes/*/result.json runs, only TWO use the strengthened 4-pattern expectation (both are mine, from this task). The 10 Sep-15 runs that report tuiSettingsSections=true used the OLDER two-pattern expectation (label 'the /settings section rendered WITH its unbridged marker', requiredPatterns=[header, /not bridged: a save here does not rewrite/]) and their pane literally shows the pre-t35 wording. The strengthening landed in commit a647d47 (2026-09-15 17:57:07, 'feat(bridge): unify the mpd settings namespace ... for both front doors') — AFTER the last comparable run — so the 4-pattern expectation has never been green on any tree, not just this wave's.

whatThePaneProves: PROVES: the REAL dsh-tui host boots in the sandbox, mounts this wave's bundle, opens /settings and RENDERS the `MPD 插件包 (mpd)` section — header, the 22-field declaration and the nine team-model slot rows with their resolved values.

PROVES: the section is not empty/degraded (it is page 1 of 42 of the plugin-settings screen) and the nine slot rows are individually VISIBLE at this geometry (they are the last nine rows of the section).
PROVES: the assertion engine is falsifiable — the script's own negative control on the same captured panes is red by design (control.ok=false).
whatThePaneDoesNotProve: NOT proven: that a user CLICKED/OPENED a slot picker — no key was sent to a slot row; the case's pattern set does not isolate the slot rows, and its single ok=false is caused by the unreachable /never lost/ pattern, so the case's own boolean is not usable as the wave's proof.
NOT proven: the full disclosure text is legible on screen — the hint is truncated at this geometry (offset 320 > 170-char cut), so the never-lost clause is composed but not visible.
NOT proven: anything about the WEB card (that is t9's evidence) or about member ROUTING (t10/t12).
Scope note: extending the case to isolate the slot rows would edit skills/** and force a VENDOR_LOCK re-pin, which this wave deliberately avoids — so the case was run as-is.
